title: Garage
subtitle: The bikes you own, how far they have gone, and what has been done to them.
empty: No bikes yet. Add one and openkoutsi can start attaching your rides to it.
name: Name
pacingNote: Tyre width and riding position are what the course pacing model reads off a bike: width sets rolling resistance, position sets how much air you push.

distance.trackedHelp: The rides openkoutsi has attached to this bike.
distance.lifetimeHelp: Tracked distance plus the starting odometer you entered.
distance.baseHelp: What the bike had already ridden before openkoutsi saw it. Without it, every wear figure here reads low.

sports.title: Rides on this bike
sports.help: Rides of these sports are attached to this bike automatically. You can always change a single ride from its own page.
sports.none: No sports claimed — rides are never attached to this bike automatically.
sports.conflict: {sport} is already on {bike}. A sport can belong to one bike only.

assignHistory.help: Look through your whole history and attach rides that have no bike yet. Rides you have already assigned are left alone.
assignHistory.done: {assigned} of {scanned} unattached rides now have a bike.
assignHistory.nothing: No unattached rides matched a bike.
assignHistory.failed: Could not go through your history

retire.help: A retired bike keeps its rides, its distance and its log, but stops collecting new ones and drops out of the course picker.
retire.confirmBody: It keeps everything it has. You can bring it back at any time.

delete.confirmBody: The rides stay, but they lose their bike and the totals here go with it. Retiring is usually what you want instead — it keeps the history.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.odometerHelp: The reading at the time. Left alone forever after — later imports never move it.

accessories.title: Fitted
accessories.name: What
accessories.help: A note of what is on the bike. It does not change any pacing prediction.

activity.title: Bike
activity.help: Change this and openkoutsi keeps your choice — reprocessing or a fresh sync will not put the match back.
